we have found the thermodynamics of a superfluid gas of Fermi atoms in a broad range of temperature and interaction strengths.

the critical temperature is determined by the entropy of the gas and not by the specific heat as it is usually assumed.
the second sound speed is a good indicator of a superfluid state and it is a good probe of the superfluid density.
